AUDIT_2026_08_10.contamination: Ontology/gate rules were tuned on this document. 95e1f20 (ontology round 3) additionally revised 4 aspect labels in this file to child nodes introduced in that same commit (air_pollutants -> .pm/.sox x3, diversity.gender -> .female).

_meta.labeler: hand-labeled from source_sentence; table values additionally verified against the Docling markdown cache (.docling_cache/ebb997f913227a52_all.json), which the v0.1 protocol could not do
_meta.source_extraction: backend/test_results/tata_docling_full.jsonl (Docling table path + llama-3.3-70b, post quality-gate, Tata Power BRSR FY24, 373 claims)
_meta.purpose: Post-Docling measuring stick. Scored against the SAME harness as gold v0.1 (baseline 63.6 on the pre-Docling mixed corpus). Caveat: v0.2 is Tata-only; v0.1 was 4-company.
_meta.how_labeled: 50 claims, stratified 25 table / 25 text (random.seed(42)). For each: read source_sentence, record the CORRECT label. Aspects are truth-first: where the taxonomy has no node for the real topic (air pollutants, water discharge, heat-rate efficiency, POSH, CSR) the gold aspect names the correct concept, so node_acc penalizes the force-fit but pillar_acc still credits the right pillar. Table values verified in the Docling cell; row labels without an FY marker are value_ambiguous (two FY columns), matching the v0.1 convention. Page furniture / form questions / header fragments are is_esg_claim=false.
_meta.note_round3: 2026-07-19: 4 aspect labels modernized to ontology round-3 child nodes (air_pollutants.pm/.sox from single-pollutant rows; gender.female from a Female-only row). Labels predate the nodes; sentences verified. The 2 genuine round-2 misses (union-table Male row -> labor_relations; POSH conciliation row) are kept unchanged.
